architectural_rule: NestNyxDev and NestNyxPro are the same application at different development/release stages, not a parent-child service dependency

dev.storage: tenant AES-256-GCM vault already exists; legacy 8-local-remote import not yet live

pro.storage: legacy RCLONE_CONFIG_B64 until reviewed independent Neon vault migration

current_observed.vercel: No NestNyx project observed in connected Vercel account; do not assume Vercel deployment or credentials

target.codebase: same reviewed NestNyx source/engine promoted by stage
target.dev: owner-bound encrypted per-remote Rclone profiles in Neon Dev; no dependency on Pro
target.pro: same owner-bound encrypted per-remote Rclone implementation in Neon Pro after Dev acceptance; own credentials and encryption key
target.isolation: distinct Neon databases, encryption keys, OAuth tenants/client settings and environment-specific URLs
target.runtime: decrypt only for authenticated owner and authorized operation; isolated 0600 temporary Rclone config; refresh token persisted AES-256-GCM under owner+connection AAD
target.prohibition: never store encryption key in Neon, Head, Body, Footer, Template or source; never copy private global Rclone config to public Dev environment
target.permissions: same connection panel and owner-bound effective grants regardless of onboarding origin; never union across profiles
target.provider_duplicates: same verified physical Drive namespace unique per owner; verified duplicate across distinct OAuth owners may be displayed without sharing authority
target.source_of_truth: Head stable rules, Body domain knowledge, Footer continuity; this JSON is draft until KEY FIN UPD GEN canonical lifecycle

release_gates: local 8 remote secrets securely staged in owner's Dev Neon vault
Pro parity port and rollback verification
